scope.purpose: Second-pass candidate discovery using full journal titles to recover papers missed by DOI-only or journal-reference-only arXiv recall.
scope.non_substitution_rule: This audit is an additive candidate pool and does not modify or replace frozen_sources.json.
scope.identity_rule: Search results are recall aids only. Acceptance requires an exact journal DOI in official arXiv metadata, an explicit publication relation in official arXiv metadata plus title and author agreement, or a documented manual title-and-author adjudication against Crossref and official arXiv metadata. Shared scientific numbers are never identity evidence.
scope.source_rule: Only a versioned arXiv e-print returning a gzip TeX source archive is accepted. PDF-only e-prints are rejected.
scope.version_rule: The fixed version must have been public no later than 2026-09-03T23:59:59Z. If a later current version exists, the last version public within the window must be fixed.

accepted.journal_title: An X-ray-emitting protocluster at z ≈ 5.7 reveals rapid structure growth
accepted.arxiv_title: An X-ray-Emitting Proto-Cluster at z≈5.7 Reveals Rapid Structure Growth
accepted.match_evidence: The official arXiv record contains the exact Nature DOI; title and all four authors agree after case, hyphenation, mathematical-markup, and diacritic normalization.

accepted.journal_title: Long-lived remote ion–ion entanglement for scalable quantum repeaters
accepted.arxiv_title: A building block of quantum repeaters for scalable quantum networks
accepted.match_evidence: The official arXiv DOI and comment explicitly identify the Nature article. The title changed substantially, but the DOI is exact and the 29-author list agrees after normalization.

accepted.journal_title: A distant brown dwarf coplanar to a warm Jupiter and a hot super-Earth
accepted.arxiv_title: A distant brown dwarf coplanar to a warm Jupiter and a hot super-Earth
accepted.match_evidence: Exact DOI, exact title, and complete author-list agreement in official journal and arXiv metadata. Version 2 was public before the audit-window endpoint.

accepted.journal_title: Discovery of a star sensitive to the spin of Sagittarius A*
accepted.arxiv_title: Discovery of a star sensitive to the spin of Sgr A*
accepted.match_evidence: The official arXiv comment states acceptance in Nature. The only title difference is the standard abbreviation Sgr versus Sagittarius; first author and the large collaboration author list agree with the journal record.

accepted.journal_title: Numerous bow shocks in the outer Helix Nebula
accepted.arxiv_title: Numerous bow shocks in the outer Helix Nebula
accepted.match_evidence: The official arXiv comment states publication in the 12 August 2026 Nature issue; title and all eight authors agree exactly after normalization.

accepted.journal_title: Towards end-to-end automation of AI research
accepted.arxiv_title: Towards End-to-End Automation of AI Research
accepted.match_evidence: The official arXiv comment states publication in Nature 651, 914–919 (2026). The normalized title is exact and the same eight authors are present; author order differs between records and is not treated as a mismatch.

accepted.journal_title: Gas-depleted planet formation occurred in the four-planet system around the red dwarf LHS 1903
accepted.arxiv_title: Gas-depleted planet formation occurred in the four-planet system around the red dwarf LHS 1903
accepted.match_evidence: Exact Science DOI and exact normalized title in official arXiv metadata; first author and collaboration author list agree.

Crossref's Science record and official arXiv metadata have the same normalized title, same first author, and same 14-author list after Unicode and punctuation normalization. No scientific result or number was used for identity.

unresolved.journal_title: Nuclear shell structure governs short-range nucleon pairing
unresolved.arxiv_title: Short-range correlated pair formation and nuclear shell structure
unresolved.match_evidence: The first author and nearly complete author set overlap and the titles are semantically close, but the official arXiv comment says 'to be submitted to Physical Review Letters' and contains no Nature DOI. This contradiction prevents acceptance without publisher-side preprint linkage or author confirmation.

false_positive_examples.title: Information leakage from data revisions in retrospective forecasts
false_positive_examples.reason: The arXiv abstract/comment cites Nature DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10658-6 as the paper being re-analysed. A DOI mention inside content is not an identity relation.

false_positive_examples.title: Dissipationless Photovoltaic Spin Hall Effect from Spin-current Vorticity
false_positive_examples.reason: Returned by a broad DOI/text search but lacks a journal DOI, explicit Nature/Science relation, or adjudicated matching journal title and authors.

provenance.journal_metadata: Crossref journal records resolved by DOI; official DOI landing pages used as the journal identity endpoint.
provenance.arxiv_metadata: Official arXiv API and official arXiv abstract pages.
provenance.source_probe: Direct byte and Content-Type probe of the versioned export.arxiv.org e-print endpoint.
provenance.notes: The full-title web search increased recall, but candidate identity was decided only from official metadata and documented manual adjudication.
